decisions.title: How should Autopilot publish to YouTube and Instagram?
options: Official APIs only (YouTube Data API + Meta Instagram API)
Also allow the existing unofficial methods (Studio browser bot, instagrapi login)
decisions.recommended: Official APIs only (YouTube Data API + Meta Instagram API)
decisions.answer: Official APIs only (YouTube Data API + Meta Instagram API)

decisions.title: Where do Autopilot's long videos come from?

Also watch my YouTube channel and clip new long videos automatically

decisions.answer: I submit them (YouTube URL, file, or a list of URLs)

decisions.title: How far should the clip editor go?

Full multi-track timeline (b-roll, transitions, joining clips)

decisions.answer: Focused clip editor (trim, word cuts, captions, hook, reframe, cover, music)
